description:
This refresh keeps InstaPrime and its patch bundle at 0.0.19, based on HushGram 0.0.19 and subsequent upstream changes. It includes 156 patches for stock Instagram 454.0.0.54.77.

### Changes since the previous 0.0.19 release

- **Messages:** DM inbox thread rows pick up the accent background and use an accent press highlight. Hide audio and video call buttons independently, or use the existing hide-all switch.
- **Downloads:** Use chosen folder for chat downloads puts chat photos and videos alongside other saves. The switch starts off, so chat media uses its usual gallery folders. A missing or inaccessible chosen folder falls back to the normal chat save.
- **Settings:** Split crowded pages in Reels, Feed, Messages, Stories, Layout, Playback, and Ads and privacy. Enable all appears when a page has at least five available switches. Search highlights the exact row it opens.
- **Appearance:** The settings header shows the current page icon with a compact 32dp back button on the right. Settings and its status bar share a tinted backdrop. The separate Black settings page option takes precedence. Selected choices use a stronger borderless fill, and the glass tab bar preview has a centered card with space around it.
- **Compatibility checks:** The APK fixture checks inbox thread fills and press highlights, prompt fills, and the Activity viewport and card hooks. It reports the matching classes and hook counts for comparison with later builds.

### Known theme gaps

Device testing confirmed the accent on DM thread rows and some Activity surfaces such as separators and You're all caught up. Regular Activity rows such as likes, login alerts, and updates still show black backgrounds. Connect contacts and Search for friends in the inbox can also remain black. The About this story sheet still needs matching accent and connected row styling. These are deferred until the next upstream update.

### Install

Use Android 9 or newer, Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer, and a matching stock Instagram 454.0.0.54.77 APK. Refresh the InstaPrime source in Morphe or import the attached patch bundle as a local source.

### Validation and credit

Focused settings, accessibility, save-folder, and theme checks passed during development. The Activity list and inbox hooks were verified against the supplied original 454 APK, and the release bundle passed verification for 156 patches and three non-empty DEX payloads. The whole-app device walkthrough and full upstream fixture gate were outside this release's validation.

Core patches, compatibility research, and upstream maintenance are by SysAdminDoc and HushGram contributors.
Original project: https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram
Support the original creator: https://ko-fi.com/X8K126YVER

### Settings UI refresh

- The settings home groups categories by purpose, with separate sections for App tools and Support and diagnostics. Layout, Profiles, Comments, and Reels have clearer subdivisions.
- Long-press a category or subcategory for a themed overview with on, off, and other counts. Pages with subcategories or named sections show a breakdown.
- The settings header has more side padding, and the page and status bar share a darker accent backdrop for clearer row separation.
- Refreshed the README screenshots and added the category overview.

The attached MPP is the exact device-tested file, with its original test build stamp. The committed source is [59e5afeff](https://github.com/FarhanZafarr-9/InstaPrime/commit/59e5afeff0a188e2960553c80b28da3cd1ec8634). The version stays at 0.0.19. SHA256SUMS.txt covers the refreshed MPP and build information. The retained CycloneDX SBOM describes the previous bundle on this release.
